headline: "There must be competition." President proposes opening Migros supermarkets in the regions
summary: The Uzbek president proposed that Turkey's Anadolu Group start developing a Migros supermarket network in Samarkand and Khorezm, then expand across the country. He said new retail chains should promote competition.
why: Anadolu Group is a Turkish conglomerate that owns the Migros retail chain, so expansion decisions affect its growth in foreign markets and competition in local grocery retail.
original_headline: “Raqobat bo‘lishi kerak”. Prezident hududlarda Migros supermarketlari ochishni taklif qildi
